protocol.primary_endpoint: Native COCO AP, selected maximum validation AP over 160 epochs
protocol.selection: All seeds fixed before launch; no ranking-dependent seed inclusion
protocol.summaries: Per-seed values; mean, sample SD and Student-t 95% CI for fixed 0/1/2 and all 0..4
protocol.failed_seeds: Recorded explicitly; no replacement seed or result-conditioned retry
protocol.dataset_policy: Existing images, partitions and FDI maps preserved; internal validation only
protocol.configuration_selection: Mobile tau=.50 and DSLR decay-only chosen using prior single-seed ablations; not independent confirmatory test evidence
